title: Amazon Aurora DSQL CDC to Amazon EventBridge
description: Stream changes from Amazon Aurora DSQL through Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and AWS Lambda to Amazon EventBridge events.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Amazon Aurora DSQL captures committed row-level changes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and streams them as JSON records to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.
AWS Lambda consumes the stream, classifies each CDC event by operation type, and publishes typed events to an Amazon EventBridge custom event bus.
Add Amazon EventBridge rules and targets to route events to any downstream consumer such as Amazon SQS, AWS Step Functions, or Amazon SNS.
Create an Amazon Aurora DSQL cluster in the Region you deploy to and wait until it is ACTIVE; Docker or Finch must be running. See the GitHub repo for the commands.
Connect to your Amazon Aurora DSQL cluster with psql and insert, update and delete a row to generate CDC events.
Add a temporary Amazon EventBridge rule with an Amazon SQS queue target on the dsql-cdc-events bus and read the events. See the GitHub repo for the exact commands.
Delete the temporary Amazon EventBridge rule, its target and the Amazon SQS queue from the testing step first: the event bus cannot be deleted while it has rules.
